name: Mini-Splatting Pipeline
definition: A training pipeline for 3D Gaussian Splatting that manages Gaussian count via densification, simplification, and depth reinitialization phases.
summary: The Mini-Splatting Pipeline is a 3D Gaussian Splatting training strategy that manages Gaussian count through periodic densification, simplification, and depth-based reinitialization to improve efficiency and reduce memory usage.
